department: Bonn-Cologne Graduate School of Physics and Astronomy (BCGS)

deadline.value: No PhD deadline: start any time by individual arrangement with a supervisor
deadline.quote: PhD: No deadline (start possible at any time; individual arrangement with the supervisor)

also.quote: PhD candidates do not need to meet any deadline and may apply throughout the year.

supervisor.value: BCGS does not provide PhD positions: find and apply for a PhD position (with a supervisor) at Bonn or Cologne yourself
supervisor.quote: Please note that the BCGS does not provide PhD positions. Students who wish to pursue a doctorate are responsible for identifying and applying for a PhD position independently.

funding.value: BCGS does not fund PhD applicants; the research groups usually provide the funding.
funding.quote: Note: BCGS does not provide funding for PhD applicants. Funding is usually provided by the research groups.

entry_route.value: An MSc (or equivalent) is required to begin PhD studies; the BCGS master's covers the coursework part.
entry_route.quote: To begin PhD studies, an MSc degree (or equivalent) is required, and candidates need to find a suitable supervisor and research project.

notes: PhD usually 3 years. Look at the University of Bonn and Cologne vacancy pages for advertised positions.
name: Universities of Bonn and Cologne
